* Key with a dot keeps the rest of the drawer
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: keep-me
:A.B: v
:END:

* Babel header arguments split at the last colon
:PROPERTIES:
:header-args:python: :session s
:header-args: :results output
:END:

* Non-ASCII key
:PROPERTIES:
:日本語プロパティ: v
:ID: still-here
:END:

* Punctuation keys org itself writes
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: anchor
:MY-PROP: y
:EFFORT+: 0:30
:X%: percent
:END:

* Single-character key with no value
:PROPERTIES:
:a:
:ID: after-a
:END:

* A line that is not a property poisons the drawer, as in Emacs
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: lost
ID: no-leading-colon
:END:
